sn35.115:1.1: “Bhikkhus, there are forms cognizable by the eye that are desirable, lovely, agreeable, pleasing, sensually enticing, tantalizing.
sn35.115:1.2: If a bhikkhu seeks delight in them, welcomes them, and remains holding to them,
sn35.115:1.3: he is called a bhikkhu who is bound among forms cognizable by the eye, who has entered Mara’s lair, who has come under Mara’s control; Mara’s snare has been fastened to him
sn35.115:1.4: so that he is bound by the bondage of Mara and the Evil One can do with him as he wishes.
sn35.115:2.1: “There are, bhikkhus, sounds cognizable by the ear …
sn35.115:2.2: mental phenomena cognizable by the mind that are desirable, lovely, agreeable, pleasing, sensually enticing, tantalizing.
sn35.115:2.3: If a bhikkhu seeks delight in them …
sn35.115:2.5: the Evil One can do with him as he wishes.
sn35.115:3.1: “There are, bhikkhus, forms cognizable by the eye that are desirable, lovely, agreeable, pleasing, sensually enticing, tantalizing.
sn35.115:3.2: If a bhikkhu does not seek delight in them, does not welcome them, and does not remain holding to them,
sn35.115:3.3: he is called a bhikkhu who is free among forms cognizable by the eye, who has not entered Mara’s lair, who has not come under Mara’s control; Mara’s snare has been unfastened from him
sn35.115:3.4: so that he is not bound by the bondage of Mara and the Evil One cannot do with him as he wishes.
sn35.115:4.1: “There are, bhikkhus, sounds cognizable by the ear …
sn35.115:4.2: mental phenomena cognizable by the mind that are desirable, lovely, agreeable, pleasing, sensually enticing, tantalizing.
sn35.115:4.3: If a bhikkhu does not seek delight in them …
sn35.115:4.5: the Evil One cannot do with him as he wishes.”
